headline: 516,140 voters eligible as voting begins in Thakurgaon-1 by-poll
summary: Polling is underway across 185 centres with heavy security, including BGB and police, to ensure a peaceful election process.
details: Voting for the Thakurgaon-1 parliamentary constituency by-election started at 8am on Thursday and will continue until 4pm. Returning officer Md Kamrul Islam reported that the process is proceeding peacefully across all 185 polling centres.
caption:
Over 516,000 voters head to the polls in Thakurgaon-1 today. Is the by-election proceeding peacefully?

Voting for the Thakurgaon-1 parliamentary constituency by-election started at 8am on Thursday and will continue until 4pm. Returning officer Md Kamrul Islam reported that the process is proceeding peacefully across all 185 polling centres.

#Thakurgaon #Bangladesh #ByElection #Politics #Election2024

Source: bdnews24.com, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star

headline: BD U-15s reach quarter-finals of FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival
summary: After two consecutive tie-breaker wins, the Bangladesh under-15 football team has advanced to the quarter-finals in Tier E of the tournament in Baku, Azerbaijan.
details: The Bangladesh U-15 football team has reached the quarter-finals of the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, after winning two consecutive matches via tie-breakers.
caption:
From tie-breakers to the quarter-finals! 🇧🇩

The Bangladesh U-15 football team has reached the quarter-finals of the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival in Baku, Azerbaijan, after winning two consecutive matches via tie-breakers.

#Bangladesh #Football #FIFA #U15WorldCup #Baku

Source: Prothom Alo
